description: Update a custom activity category owned by the authenticated user by id. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips. Destructive: overwrites supplied fields on an existing Tripsy record; previous values are not automatically preserved or restored by this tool.

icon_name.description: Icon name metadata for this category, such as golf.

name.description: Custom category display name, such as Golf Clubs.
